name: Pleasant Dreams
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 2, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration 24 hours
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The touched creature is protected from influenced dreams, whether of mundane or magic origin. Pleasant dreams prevents the effects of dreamwalker, night terrors, nightmare, the dream haunting of a night hag, and similar sleep disturbances. The spell also protects the target creature from naturally occurring nightmares.
